Research/2025-26

Annual archive

2025-26 projects

8 concise research records. Each page stands on its own as an account of the question, method, and result; retained papers, posters, and tjSTAR records provide the full artifacts.

Exoplanets

Analyzing VLTI/GRAVITY Data of Beta Pictoris b for Exomoon-Induced Exoplanetary Wobble

A search for an exomoon signal in the tiny astrometric motion of a directly imaged exoplanet.

Available: Paper · Poster · tjSTAR record

Early universe

Primordial Black Hole Formation from QCD-like Equation-of-State Transitions

A numerical-relativity study of how an early-universe phase transition can change the threshold for black-hole collapse.

Available: Paper · tjSTAR record

Black-hole origins

Constraining Black-Hole Seeds with JWST Little Red Dots

A comparison of light and heavy seed-growth histories for massive black holes observed early in cosmic history.

Available: Paper · Poster · tjSTAR record

Computational astrophysics

Primordial Black Holes and Population III Star Formation

An exploratory particle simulation of how central black-hole mass relates to star formation in an early-galaxy model.

Available: Paper · Poster · tjSTAR record

Galactic center

Investigating the Origins of the Fermi Bubbles with CMHD Simulations

A simulation-based comparison of two explanations for the enormous bipolar structures above and below the Milky Way.

Available: Poster · tjSTAR record

Instrumentation

SPINNI: A Miniaturized Sagnac Interferometer

A compact optical prototype designed toward portable planetary rotation measurements.

Available: Poster · tjSTAR record

Planetary engineering

Building a Tumbleweed Rover for Mars

A lightweight wind-driven rover prototype and an initial attempt to scale terrestrial test results to Mars.

Available: Poster · tjSTAR record

Radio transients

V-SPARC: Detecting Long-Period Transients with VLITE

A search of archival low-frequency radio observations for rare sources that pulse on minute-to-hour timescales.

Available: Paper · Poster · tjSTAR record
